selection.rule: highest training-set selection score among the headline models; test metrics never used
selection.score: cv_auc (5-fold stratified CV on the training set); oof_auc where the CV ran on a tuning subsample

best_by.note: descriptive only: which model leads on each metric; selection uses the CV score (see 'selection')

bootstrap.method: paired row bootstrap of the 8,990 test rows; percentile 95 % intervals

runtime.note: fit_seconds semantics differ by script (final refit only vs whole grid); wall-clock on a shared laptop

cv_notes.svm_rbf: cv_auc measured on a 6,000-row tuning subsample (not comparable; use oof_auc)

segments.descriptor: UTIL_MEAN low (-0.9 SD), UTIL_1 low (-0.9 SD), PAY_3 low (-0.8 SD)
BILL_AMT4 high (+2.3 SD), BILL_AMT3 high (+2.3 SD), BILL_AMT5 high (+2.3 SD)
UTIL_1 high (+0.6 SD), LIMIT_BAL low (-0.5 SD), UTIL_MEAN high (+0.5 SD)
N_MONTHS_DELAYED high (+2.4 SD), MAX_DELAY high (+1.7 SD), PAY_3 high (+1.7 SD)
